title: 1800s Downtown Loft | Heart of Music City
description:
Stay in the heart of it all! This stylish historic loft is steps from Broadway’s Honky Tonks, 2nd Ave, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium—you truly can’t beat the location. With 3 comfy beds, 1 bath, a full kitchen, in-unit laundry, modern furnishings, and parking included, it’s ideal for groups. Good to know: the building dates to the 1800s, so occasional dust may occur. Stairs are required, and you will hear downtown noise, especially at night.

The space
The property is on the corner of Broadway and 2nd Ave. IDEAL LOCATION!

Guest access
24 Hour Automated Guest Check-in/out

Other things to note
Due to our unbeatable downtown location, you will hear ambient noise from nearby bars, especially at night—ideal for guests who want to be steps from the action.

Good to know: The building dates to the 1800s, so occasional dust or a rare bug may occur.

Parking for one car is included in a garage one block away and will be validated during your stay.

Please note: One flight of stairs is required to access the apartment; there is no elevator.

Local discounts, baggage services, party & bachelorette planning, and décor services available upon request.
